title: 第一卷 第12章 和你那一夜，是第一次
content_zh:
看着他离开的背影，赵亦可深吸一口气，“他会不会，爱上她了？”

    “怎么可能？”秦柯反应很大，“才认识几天，不可能爱上的。你就放心吧，他做这一切，都是为了不让你受伤害。”

    赵亦可咬唇，眼里有不甘心，“我根本就不怕。”

    “他怕呀。”秦柯劝着她，“他不会让你受一丝一毫的伤害的。你相信他，他跟童喻，来不了真的。”

    赵亦可握紧双手，声音轻颤，“他也跟我说过，只是玩玩。可是，以前除了我，他身边没有过别的女人。现在，童喻能够堂而皇之地站在他身边。”

    秦柯不知道怎么劝了，只能看向傅承言。

    傅承言轻轻扶了一下眼镜，“你跟他青梅竹马的感情，不是几天认识的人就能够取代的。”

    “青梅竹马”四个字，让赵亦可浮躁的心安稳了下来。

    。

    童喻站在走廊里，地面的高反光大理石在光影下，拼花纹路泛着细碎的光芒，她靠着墙壁，恬静又孤寂。

    她没有再走进去，里面的气氛不太适合她。

    霍放一出来就看到童喻站在那里，她这是故意躲出来的。

    手上的烟没点，夹在指间，走向她。

    厚密的绒毯吸纳了脚步声，他都站在她身边了，她才回了头。

    童喻被惊到了。

    “不喜欢和他们在一起？”霍放跟她一样，靠墙而站，点燃了烟，吸了一口。

    他偏头看她，眼眸幽深。

    童喻闻着烟味，调整情绪，轻扬唇角，“你们是好友，我在那里会影响你们聊天的。”

    “不想融入我的世界？”

    “二少说了，只是玩玩，还是要有边界感。”

    “边界感？”

    霍放反复品着这个词。

    忽地笑了。

    他垂眸睨着手上的烟火星子，把它用力地摁在了灭烟桶里。

    手臂钻进了童喻的腰后，轻轻一捞，就让她的身体远离了墙壁，转到了自己面前。

    别人看起来，像是童喻按着霍放。

    童喻双手无处可放，只能撑在他的胸前，隔开了身体紧贴的可能。

    她漂亮的眼睛里闪烁着光，带着几分惊讶。

    “刚在你跟他们说，我说你腰粗的时候，你怎么没有想到边界感？”霍放的手量着她的腰，兴起时在她腰是轻轻一捏。

    童喻有一点点怕痒，毕竟这个地方很敏感。
content_en:
Looking at his leaving figure, Zhao Yike took a deep breath and asked, "Could he have fallen in love with her?"

    "How is that possible?" Qin Ke reacted greatly, "We have only known each other for a few days, so it is impossible to fall in love with him. Don't worry, he did all this to prevent you from getting hurt."

    Zhao Yike bit his lip, with a look of reluctance in his eyes, "I'm not afraid at all."

    "He's afraid." Qin Ke persuaded her, "He won't let you get hurt in the slightest. You believe him. It's true that he and Tong Yu can't come together."

    Zhao Yike clenched his hands and his voice trembled slightly, "He also told me that it was just for fun. However, except for me, there was no other woman beside him before. Now, Tong Yu can stand beside him openly."

    Qin Ke didn't know how to persuade him, so he could only look at Fu Chengyan.

    Fu Chengyan adjusted his glasses slightly, "The relationship between you and his childhood sweetheart cannot be replaced by someone you have known for a few days."

    The four words "childhood sweetheart" calmed Zhao Yike's impetuous heart.

    .

    Tong Yu stood in the corridor. The highly reflective marble on the ground shone with tiny pieces of light under the light and shadow. She leaned against the wall, feeling quiet and lonely.

    She didn't go in again, the atmosphere inside didn't suit her.

    As soon as Huo Fang came out, he saw Tong Yu standing there. She hid on purpose.

    The cigarette in his hand was not lit, but he held it between his fingers and walked towards her.

    The thick velvet blanket absorbed the sound of footsteps, and he was standing beside her before she turned back.

    Tong Yu was shocked.

    "Don't like being with them?" Huo Fang stood against the wall like her, lit a cigarette and took a puff.

    He tilted his head to look at her, his eyes dark.

    Tong Yu smelled the smell of smoke, adjusted his mood, and raised the corners of his lips slightly, "You are good friends, and my being there will affect your chat."

    "Don't you want to fit into my world?"

    "Second Young Master said, it's just for fun, but you still have to have a sense of boundaries."

    "A sense of boundaries?"

    Huo Fang repeated the word.

    Suddenly laughed.

    He lowered his eyes and stared at the sparks in his hand, then pressed them hard into the cigarette extinguisher.

    His arms went behind Tong Yu's waist, and with a gentle pull, she moved her body away from the wall and turned to face him.

    To others, it looks like Tong Yu pressing Huo Fang.

    Tong Yu had nowhere to put his hands, so he could only hold them on his chest, blocking the possibility of being close to him.

    Her beautiful eyes sparkled with a hint of surprise.

    "When you told them that you had a thick waist, why didn't you think of boundaries?" Huo Fang's hand measured her waist, and when he felt up, he pinched her waist gently.

    Tong Yu is a little ticklish, after all, this place is very sensitive.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 12 That night with you was the first time
